summary: Backend testing for Estoque API completed. All 22 tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/logout), store config (default/update/isolation), products CRUD (create/list/get/update/delete), stock adjustments (+/- with floor at 0), and multi-user isolation. Admin seed login works (admin@estoque.com/admin123). Bearer token and cookie auth both supported. No _id leakage. 401 enforced on protected routes. Cross-user access returns 404.

minor.issue: Cookies use SameSite=None; Secure=True which requires HTTPS - works for the public preview URL but will not work over plain HTTP in local dev.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers.
Rejects empty updates with 400 'Nada para atualizar' - not tested against contract but acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes password auth and Google OAuth cleanly; consider splitting into modules once file grows further (currently 372 lines).

adjust_stock does read-then-write without atomic $inc; concurrent -1 clicks may race. Recommend {$inc:{quantidade_estoque: delta}} with subsequent floor via aggregation update or a conditional {$max:0} guarantee.
CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] would be rejected by browsers; here FRONTEND_URL is appended so effective origins list contains explicit origin - OK.
JWT expiration is 7 days without refresh; acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Tests dynamically register users test_a_*/test_b_*/test_reg_* per run. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated. Frontend testing pending: dashboard cards, stock badges (green/yellow/red), quick actions, WhatsApp wa.me link generation, config screen, login flow, Emergent Google auth.
